verdict.rationale: Bitwarden generates TOTP codes and syncs them between its Authenticator and Password Manager apps, so a smartwatch surface is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions a smartwatch, Apple Watch, Wear OS or any other wearable app or companion. Phone and browser TOTP support is a different surface and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone
